card.name: Drug lowering another drug's concentration
card.fires_on: The word that says a drug will lower levels, such as "reduction in", "may reduce" or "may decrease", right before a drug's concentration is named in an interaction statement.

modes.label: Reduction in
modes.description: The word "in" after "reduction" just before a drug name and concentrations.
modes.example: results in a reduction<< in>> valproic acid concentrations.

modes.label: May decrease or reduce
modes.description: A verb meaning lower, after "may", just before plasma or serum concentrations of a named drug.
modes.example: with lithium may<< decrease>> serum lithium concentrations.

card.plain: It marks the spot in a drug interaction sentence where one drug is said to lower the blood level of another.
